item.title: Kosciusko County Parks and Recreation Board Hears About Friends of the Trail
item.description: The Kosciusko County Parks and Recreation Board heard about the Friends of the Trail during its regular meeting Thursday, Feb. 12.

item.title: State Announces Workshops Around The State For Feedback On Water Plan
item.description: The Indiana Department of Natural Resources will host seven workshops across Indiana to allow Hoosiers to provide input on the development of a statewide water inventory and management plan under an executive order by Gov. Mike Braun.

item.title: Grace College, Area Churches Partner For Supermarket Sweep
item.description: Grace College is partnering with five local churches to host the 15th annual Supermarket Sweep on Wednesday, Feb. 18, at Kroger, 2211 E. Center St., Warsaw.

item.title: Lawmakers Looking To Require More Indiana Child Abuse Investigation Information
item.description: Indiana’s Department of Child Services would have to publicly release more information about child abuse cases resulting in deaths under changes moving through the Legislature.

item.title: $131,000 Donation Pushes Magical Meadows Expansion Toward Completion
item.description: The Magical Meadows therapeutic horseback riding facility is celebrating continued momentum in its Growing with Heart Capital Campaign and Expansion Project with the announcement of a $131,000 contribution from Dr. Gregory Haase and Melody Barker-Haase.

item.title: BMV Rule Barring Gender Marker Changes Effective This Week
item.description: Starting Thursday, Feb. 12, the Indiana Bureau of Motor Vehicles will no longer provide customers with the option to change their gender on their Indiana credential by using a court-ordered gender change or physician statement.

item.title: Brette Stamper Promoted to Detective Sergeant At Kosciusko County Sheriff’s Office
item.description: The Kosciusko County Sheriff's Office Merit Board voted to promote Detective Brette Stamper to Detective Sergeant; hire Micah Mansfield as a merit deputy; and give Peyton Hendrix a conditional offer for the next merit deputy opening during a meeting on Thursday, Feb. 12.
